title: Gen Z is the most online generation but this Christmas, they want gifts to get them outside
claim: PwC's 2026 Holiday Outlook survey: 78% of Gen Z interested in screen-free gifts such as puzzles and art supplies (gift-intent survey)
excerpt: Nearly four in five Gen Zers (78%) are interested in screen-free gifts like puzzles, art supplies and gift cards, as compared to 64% for all consumers.
